souvenir = a small object you buy to remember a place
package holiday = a holiday where travel and hotel are booked together
go abroad = to travel to another country
get lost = to not know where you are
traffic jam = a long line of cars that cannot move
petrol station = a place where you buy fuel for a car
train timetable = a list of times when trains leave
ferry = a boat that carries people and cars across water
long-distance coach = a comfortable bus for long journeys
aisle = the corridor between seats
window seat = a seat next to the window
cancelled = stopped and not happening as planned
resort = a town or hotel area designed for holidays
landmark = a famous building or place that helps you recognise a city
hitchhike = to travel by asking drivers to take you for free
overland = travelling by road or rail, not by air
airport = the place where planes take off and land
flight = a journey by plane
passenger = a person travelling in a plane, train, bus or car
passport = an official document that lets you travel to another country
